description: EMBOSS 6.6 needle: global alignment (Needleman-Wunsch with Gotoh's three matrices) in the arithmetic and with the conventions of the program: a gap of length k costs gapOpen + (k-1)*gapExtend (positive penalties, EMBOSS -gapopen / -gapextend, rounded to 16 mantissa bits as EMBOSS does), scores are single-precision floats, and end gaps are FREE unless endWeight (-endweight): then an end gap of length k costs endOpen + (k-1)*endExtend (-endopen / -endextend). Rows (ties included), score and the printed score text are those of the installed needle 6.6.0. Default matrix EDNAFULL (both sequences nucleotide) or EBLOSUM62. exactScore is the single-precision score of the program, score its rounding. VERIFICATION: rows and printed score identical on 887 / 887 committed random DNA / IUPAC / protein pairs (1-200 residues, integer / dyadic / non-dyadic gap penalties, 445 without and 442 with end-gap weights, 10 matrices). Sequences whose matrices would exceed 2^27 = 134 217 728 cells are refused (the program keeps three float matrices and a compass matrix, 16 bytes per cell): use stretcher_align (linear space). Use format / write_alignment (program 'needle') for the EMBOSS output files. Input sequences are read as EMBOSS reads them (A4-3, one shared reader): only letters and '*' are kept; gap characters (- . ~ ?), '#', '+', '_', digits, blanks and every other character are dropped first, and positions, lengths and scores count the cleaned sequence (e.g. needle of AC-GTTAGC.TT* and ACGTTAGCTT: score 58, length 11, as the program).

sequence1.description: First sequence (-asequence), at least one residue.

sequence2.description: Second sequence (-bsequence), at least one residue.

matrix.description: Optional EMBOSS data matrix (-datafile): EBLOSUM62, EPAM250, EDNAFULL, ... or the NCBI name. Omit for EDNAFULL (nucleotide) / EBLOSUM62 (protein).

gapOpen.description: Gap opening penalty (-gapopen, 1 - 100): the cost of a gap of length 1.

gapExtend.description: Gap extension penalty (-gapextend, 0 - 10): the cost of each further gap position.

endWeight.description: -endweight: apply the end-gap penalties (default false: end gaps are free).

endOpen.description: -endopen (1 - 100): cost of an end gap of length 1 (used only with endWeight).

endExtend.description: -endextend (0 - 10): cost of each further end-gap position (used only with endWeight).

format.description: Optional output format; the alignment written in that format is returned in the result field 'formatted'. Biopython Bio.Align names: fasta, a2m, clustal, phylip, nexus, stockholm (byte for byte as Bio.Align.write; 'emboss:' + name selects the EMBOSS writer of the same name). EMBOSS -aformat names: pair, simple, srspair, srs, markx0, markx1, markx2, markx3, markx10, match, score, sam, tcoffee (two rows) and msf, mega, meganon, nexusnon, paup, paupnon, phylipnon, selex, treecon (any number of rows; EMBOSS prints the run date: now, UTC). Omit for no formatted text.

names.description: Optional names of the rows for the formatted output (default seq1, seq2, ...).

sequenceQualifiers.description: EMBOSS sequence-input qualifiers as on the command line, with the input number: -sbegin1 3 -send1 -2 -sreverse1 -slower1 -supper1 -scircular1 -snucleotide1 -sprotein1 and the same with 2 for the second sequence (begin / end: 1-based, negative = from the end; -sreverse: reverse-complement a nucleotide sequence, the range then refers to the original; -snucleotide / -sprotein force the type). Measured on EMBOSS 6.6.0: the alignment covers the range, and the formatted alignment (default format 'pair') reports the positions of the ORIGINAL sequence, counting down for a reversed one. Omit for the whole sequences.

endPosition1.description: End of the aligned part in sequence1.

endPosition2.description: End of the aligned part in sequence2.

exactScore.description: The single-precision score of the program.

formatted.description: The alignment written in the requested format (null when format is omitted).

errors.message: a sequence argument is null or empty / names and matrix have the wrong shape
a gap penalty is outside the range of the program / unknown matrix
